<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_HandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" name="Recommendation review path"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check recommendation and mark claim"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOK" name="Claim marked OK?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_HandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="EndEvent_HandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
